subject: Paperflow decision ladder — procurement milestones & next actions
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixtx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Paperflow decision ladder — procurement milestones & next actions

Hi Sara / Helix team,

Thanks again for the convo this morning — good clarity on requirements and the internal sign-off path. Quick recap + proposed mutual action plan so we keep momentum:

- Commercial path under consideration: PO (preferred by procurement) OR company card OR cloud marketplace listing. You mentioned marketplace would help with procurement velocity if available.
- Internal gates you listed: Legal review (T&Cs / SOW), Security questionnaire (RFI + scope of logging/data handling), Finance (billing instrument + PO issuance).
- Proposed high-level timeline (rough): Legal review 5–7 business days -> Security review 10–14 business days -> Finance issues PO 3–7 business days after approved SOW/invoice. These are placeholder estimates we can tighten once legal/security intake forms are submitted.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ve attached a one-page mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx with milestone owners and dates — please review and edit where needed.
2) Can your procurement team confirm preferred payment instrument (PO vs card) and whether marketplace procurement is required?
3) If you can, please send the completed RFI spreadsheet (security) and any internal legal redlines to this thread.

Action owners (proposed):
- Helix: complete RFI + indicate payment path (Sara / Rajiv)
- Redwood: fill SOW template and return draft to legal (Ben)
- Redwood Security: pre-fill standard controls checklist and return to you (Karthik)

I’ll follow up with an updated MAP snapshot by end of day Friday.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Paperflow decision ladder — procurement milestones & next actions

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement/legal side:

- Procurement preference: PO (we have controls around invoices and supplier onboarding). Card only for pilots under $5k and with an internal non-production exception.
- Marketplace: Helix prefers marketplace if pricing and SLAs are comparable — it short-circuits procurement for some business units, but not all (depends on billing owner). We need to confirm whether Redwood is available via the major cloud marketplaces or if a marketplace SOW is different.
- Security RFI: attaching our initial RFI (Helix_RFI.xlsx). We try to complete the security review within ~10 business days but it can slip if product/security teams have follow-ups.
- Legal: our legal lead will run standard redlines; we typically target 7–10 business days but may escalate for a pilot.

Timeline from our side (best-effort):
- RFI back to you by Mon, Apr 26 (we’ll try sooner)
- Legal redlines by Fri, May 6
- Finance/PO issuance: once SOW/invoice accepted, PO in 3–7 business days.

We’ve looped Rajiv (finance) — he’ll confirm if the cost center needs an internal PO vs procurement-managed PO.

Attachment: Helix_RFI.xlsx (RFI spreadsheet stub)

Thanks — Sara
Sara Patel
Director, Strategic Procurement
Helix Therapeutics

Evelyn — nice capture. A couple of tactical items from my side:

- I’ll draft the SOW template today and aim to have a Redwood draft back to Helix by Friday EOD. That will help the legal turnaround.
- Karthik, can you pre-populate the common security responses for Helix_RFI.xlsx? Focus on data residency, KV cache policies, and audit logs — those are usually the quick hits.
- If Helix indicates marketplace is required to move forward (Sara — can you flag which business units?), we’ll surface any pricing delta and whether marketplace listing affects data residency / SLA terms.

Proposed adjusted timeline (Redwood commitments):
- SOW draft to Helix: Fri, Apr 23
- Security responses initial pass: Tue, Apr 27
- Revised MAP (w/ dates & owners): Thu, Apr 29

I’ll own the SOW and commercial gate; Evelyn you can own the MAP updates and coordination with Rajiv for PO path.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — following up with the MAP snapshot and explicit owners/dates after the internal updates we discussed. Summary below and attached MAP_v1.xlsx + security-responses.docx (initial answers).

Confirmed path & milestones:
- Legal (Redwood draft SOW -> Helix legal review): Redwood to send SOW by 2027-04-23 (Ben). Helix legal target complete by 2027-05-06 (Sara).
- Security (Helix RFI -> Redwood responses -> Helix follow-up): Helix to return RFI by 2027-04-26 (Sara). Redwood to return initial responses by 2027-04-27 (Karthik).
- Finance (Invoice/SOW accepted -> Helix issues PO): Target PO issuance window 2027-05-07 to 2027-05-13 dependent on legal finish (Rajiv).

Action items (owners):
- Sara / Helix: confirm marketplace requirement and indicate which business units need marketplace procurement by Tue, Apr 27.
- Ben / Redwood: finalize SOW and include pilot pricing; deliver by Fri, Apr 23.
- Karthik / Redwood Security: complete RFI answers and send security-responses.docx by Tue, Apr 27.
- Evelyn / Redwood AE: update MAP and coordinate weekly 15-min syncs (starting Mon, Apr 26).

If Helix confirms PO path we’ll include billing contact and PO template in the next update. If they request a marketplace purchase, we’ll add an SPA step to the MAP and flag any pricing variance.

Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan snapshot), security-responses.docx (initial answers)

I’ll schedule the first 15-min sync for Mon Apr 26 — invite will be sent separately.

Best — Evelyn
